editorial.intro: Autocar truck clipart spans concrete mixers, terminal tractors, dump trucks and refuse vehicles. Square work cabs, rounded vintage fronts and articulated truck combinations show different sides of the brand in illustrated industrial settings. Loads, body shapes and cab details give the individual drawings distinct subjects.
